name: [forge-admin] Watch search deadline failures
message: Watch search exceeded its request budget at least three times in five minutes. Inspect the stage field and correlated APM trace. For serving_profile, inspect transcript compatibility preparation and database pool waiting; language_resolution and availability_hydration require their own attribution. This count is not a population error rate. A healthy /api/search/health does not establish successful search delivery. Follow docs/reports/2026-10-23-watch-search-timeout-investigation.md. Confirm the serving revision and cold/warm known-query results before recovery sign-off. Do not extend deadlines or restart services as an automatic response.
